result: COMPAT-19 implemented: GLIBC_TUNABLES=niji.compat.execstack=1 accepts executable-stack programs, start-up dependencies and dlopen'd libraries and makes the main and library-made thread stacks executable; default refusal now names object, program or dlopen caller and the ways in; secure processes ignore it; allowlist amendment registered

gate.affected: FULL escalated (xtask/src/so.rs): no gate; changed crates' tests 4481 passed / 0 failed (136 suites); exec_stack 5/5

rulings.item: Start-up cost of the accept flag: one relaxed load+branch in run_init per dynamic start, one relaxed load per pthread_create under the list lock; not counted with wl_percall
rulings.recommendation: accept (about 2 instructions per start); a zero-cost variant would pass the flag through the C library's early-init argument, a larger change
